rationale: The camera fails to function even when placed next to the base station and after a factory reset. The user has also tried a different power outlet and cable, ruling out power issues. Other devices work, so the base station and network are likely fine. This points to a hardware fault in the camera itself.

output.symptom_summary: Study camera is broken even when placed beside the base station after resetting. LED goes solid and then dark again. Tried different power outlet and cable. Other devices work.
key_abnormal_indicators: Camera fails to function even when placed next to the base station
LED goes solid and then dark again
Different power outlet and cable do not resolve the issue
Other devices in the system work normally
output.customer_reply: Thank you for the detailed information. Based on the symptoms you described, it appears that the camera may have a hardware fault. Since the camera fails to work even when placed next to the base station and after a factory reset, and other devices are functioning normally, we suspect a hardware issue with the camera. We recommend contacting our support team for further assistance, possibly including a replacement if the device is under warranty.

complaint: My study camera is still broken even beside the base station after resetting the camera. I carried it into the same room as the base station, plugged it in and held the reset button for 10 seconds as the manual says; the LED goes solid and then dark again. I also tried a different power outlet and a different cable. Everything else in the system works.
usability_reason: The response is clear, polite, and actionable, accurately summarizing the customer's reported symptoms and recommending contact for replacement. It avoids claiming unperformed checks or fixes. However, actionability is somewhat limited since it only directs to support without specific next steps, and the root-cause label is appropriately framed as a suspicion rather than a confirmed diagnosis.
